leadText: The Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 1 is the first monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the first chapter of the manga, Pikachu, I See You!. This along with the next three chapters would be later recollected in graphic novel format by VIZ Media into .
plainText:
The Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 1 is the first monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the first chapter of the manga, Pikachu, I See You!. This along with the next three chapters would be later recollected in graphic novel format by VIZ Media into .

==Publications==
 
 
 
 

 

==Chapters==
Pikachu, I See You!

==Important events==
Ash and Gary begin their journeys.
Ash gets a Pikachu.
Ash meets .
Ash steals Misty's bike, and then wrecks it.
Ash reaches Viridian City.
Ash catches a .

==Translation edits==
When this issue was originally published, few changes were made to the original artwork. May Oak was depicted with large breasts, and 's top revealed some cleavage. When the collected volume was later released, however, May's breasts were redrawn to be much smaller and Misty's top was recolored to a black one which does not reveal any cleavage.
